label: Choose a path
description: Sends the workflow down different paths depending on the data, like “if the ticket is urgent go here, otherwise go there”. The first rule that matches wins; if none match it takes the default path.

cases.title: Rules

when.title: Condition
when.description: When this is true, take this path. Example: state.priority == "high" (CEL expression).

route.title: Path name
route.description: A short name in lowercase, e.g. urgent. It appears as an output on the block.

cases.description: Checked top to bottom; the first rule whose condition is true picks the path.
